Section 1. Purpose and Application 
  
1.1. These Policy and Procedures for room allocation and accommodation in 
dormitories of the autonomous organization of education Nazarbayev University 
(hereinafter - the Policy and Procedures) establish the procedure for room allocation, 
check-in/check-out, relocating, eviction, general accommodation requirements, 
payment procedures, use, and maintenance of premises provided to students of the 
autonomous organization of education Nazarbayev University (hereinafter - the 
University), except for students of postgraduate and residency programs. The Policy 
and Procedures also regulate the appointment of resident assistants. 
1.2. These Policy and Procedures apply to all University students and resident 
assistants residing on the University premises.

Procedures:

accommodation services under which a student or resident assistants is provided with 
accommodation services in a dormitory; 
2) Occupational Safety and Health Department (OSHD) - a structural 
division of the University responsible for security on the University campus; 
3) Department of Student Services (DSS) – a structural division of the 
University responsible for organizational and educational work among students, 
including matters related to student accommodation on the University campus;

3.1.14. Applications for a place change in the dormitory must be submitted via

correctly and places are available, the DSS will approve the change, update the list,

reason for the relocation. 
The Entity shall provide the student with the designated place within 5 (five) 
working days from the date of receiving the corresponding email from the DSS. To 
complete the relocation, the student must sign the relevant act of acceptance-transfer 
within 5 (five) working days of receiving the relocation notification from the DSS.  
3.1.15. If there are vacant places in the dormitory after the accommodation of

Executive Vice President of the University.

04.08.2026 # 04.08.26.
